name: ReCarbon
tagline: Native recompilation of Need for Speed: Carbon (Xbox 360) for Apple Silicon.
summary: A static recompilation, not an emulator: the game's PowerPC code is translated to C++ ahead of time with XenonRecomp and compiled to native arm64. Built on SpeedBreaker. No Wine, CrossOver or runtime CPU emulation.

status.label: Released — Playable
status.note: The first playable release (v0.1.0): full races on the keyboard, on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 27. Download and install steps are on the project site; you need your own Xbox 360 disc image. Known limitations are listed there.
status.source: ReCarbon v0.1.0 release notes and Known Issues

requirements: Your own legally obtained copy of the Xbox 360 disc

upstream.name: SpeedBreaker
upstream.note: the static recompilation by project(u) that ReCarbon builds on; its runtime is adapted for ReCarbon

upstream.name: XenonRecomp
upstream.note: the recompiler that translates the PowerPC code to C++

legal.disclaimer: ReCarbon is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Electronic Arts Inc. or the Need for Speed brand. Need for Speed and Carbon are trademarks of Electronic Arts Inc. and are used here only to describe the game. No game files are included or distributed: you need your own legally obtained copy of the Xbox 360 disc.

name: reFrozen
tagline: Native recompilation of Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne (1.26a) for Apple Silicon.
summary: Planned with the same method as ReCarbon: statically recompile the game's x86 Win32 code (war3.exe and Game.dll 1.26a) for arm64, on a native runtime that replaces Win32, Direct3D 8/9, DirectSound and Storm, so that DotA Allstars (v6.83) plays on macOS without Wine or a VM. Whether this is feasible is still being studied.

status.label: Planning
status.note: Feasibility research (M0) is in progress; nothing is built yet. No releases or downloads.

requirements: Your own legally obtained copy of Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos and The Frozen Throne

legal.disclaimer: reFrozen is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. Warcraft and The Frozen Throne are trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. and are used here only to describe the game. DotA Allstars is a community map by its respective authors. No game files are included or distributed: you need your own legally obtained copy of Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos and The Frozen Throne.
